div.ab: Cyld binnan XXX nihtum sy gefullod; gif hit swa ne sy, xxx scll' gebete.
XLVI. Cild binnan ðritegum nihta sie gefulwad; gif hit swa ne sie, XXX scill. gebete.
Puer infra triginta noctes baptizetur; si non sit, XXX sol. emendetur.
{XVI} Cild binnan ðritegum nihta sie gefulwad; gif hit swa ne sie, xxx sciƚƚ gebete.
A child must be baptized within thirty nights; if it is not, let him pay 30 shillings.
A child shall be baptised within 30 days. If this is not done, [the guardian] shall pay 30 shillings compensation.
A child is to be baptised within 30 days; if it is not, 30 shillings compensation is to be paid.
Ein Kind werde binnen 30 Nächten getauft. Wenn es nicht so [getauft] wird, büsse [sein Vormund dem König] 30 Schill.
Let a child be baptised within 30 nights. If it is not so [baptised], let [its guardian] pay [the king] 30 shillings.
